messages.subject: Error when running GENEActiv BIN files
parts:
Hi all, 

I am having some trouble running some BIN files. For context, I am running GGIR version v3.0.6 and GGIRread v0.3.3. I am running into a problem straight away in part 1. see below code for params, part 1 and 2 (have chopped of part 3,4,5 here). Note this code works on Axivity cwa files. 

mode= c(1,2,3,4,5)
datadir= "removed for security" #where is the data stored
outputdir= "remove for data security" #Where do you want to store the data?
studyname="Lean" #study name
f0 = 1 #file to start with
f1 = 2 #file to end with
GGIR(#-------------------------------
             # General parameters
             #-------------------------------
             mode=mode,
             datadir=datadir,
             outputdir=outputdir,
             studyname=studyname,
             f0=f0,
             f1=f1,
             overwrite = FALSE,
             do.imp=TRUE,
             idloc=1,
             print.filename=TRUE,
             storefolderstructure = FALSE,
             myfun = myfun,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 1 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             windowsizes = c(5,900,3600), #5 s epoch, 15 min non-wear detection resolution, 60 min non-wear evaluation window
             do.cal=TRUE,
             do.enmo = TRUE, #ENMO physical activity metric
             do.anglez=TRUE, # for sleep analysis
             do.anglex=TRUE,
             do.angley=TRUE,
             chunksize=1,
             printsummary=TRUE,
             #-------------------------------
             # Part 2 parameters:
             #-------------------------------
             strategy = 1, #see tutorial for explanation of strategies
             ndayswindow=7,
             hrs.del.start = 0,
             hrs.del.end = 0,
             maxdur = 10,
             includedaycrit = 10, # min valid hrs per day
             qwindow=c(0,24), #window for calculation of quantiles
             mvpathreshold =c(100,250,400), #thresholds for MVPA, total and bouts 1, 5 & 10 min acceleration>threshold for >80% of time d=or Hildebrand moderate (100) and vigorous thresholds (400) and for brisk walking (250)
             boutcriter = c(0.8),
             mvpadur = c(1,5,10),
             bout.metric = 6,

Please see below full error message in part 1. 
Part 1 Checking that user has read access permission for all files in data directory: Yes Busy processing ... see C:"directory removed" /meta/basic for progress Errors and warnings for LM001_left wrist_026152_2022-11-28 14-49-15.bin$message [1] "incorrect number of dimensions" $call peak_info[, 2] Errors and warnings for LM002_left wrist_026573_2022-11-28 15-51-57.bin$message [1] "incorrect number of dimensions" $call peak_info[, 2]

which then leads to connection error in part 2

Part 2 1 Error in readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) : cannot open the connection In addition: Warning messages: 1: In GGIR(mode = mode, datadir = datadir, outputdir = outputdir, studyname = studyname, :
Any thoughts on what I might be doing wrong?

thanks

James

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Error when running GENEActiv BIN files
parts:
Hi James,

This was a bug introduced in 3.0-6 and fixed in 3.0-7 (only on GitHub for now) and affects the use of the external function embedding option (such as verisense step count).

In 3.0-6 part 1 had undergone a major clean up (credits to contributor Lena), which has made the code a lot more readable and efficient. Despite extensive testing this was one of the side effects, but luckily now fixed.

Vincent
